title: Subject-request completion lab
description: Trace an access, deletion, or consent-withdrawal request across primary records, derived data, exports, and backups.

requests.label: Access and export
requests.detail: Return the subject's data, purposes, recipients, and provenance in an understandable package.

requests.label: Delete personal data
requests.detail: Remove or irreversibly de-identify eligible records and prove the remaining exceptions.

requests.label: Withdraw consent
requests.detail: Stop consent-based processing immediately and prevent downstream reuse.

estates.label: Mapped lineage
estates.detail: Primary stores, derived tables, vendors, and backup policy have registered owners.

estates.label: Partial lineage
estates.detail: Primary applications are mapped, but analytics marts and one export vendor are not.

estates.label: Shadow exports
estates.detail: Teams copied profile data into unmanaged files and long-lived support exports.

notice: Real deadlines, exemptions, identity checks, and backup handling depend on jurisdiction and policy. The architecture must expose those rules as reviewable evidence.
